question: Can a directly programmable 3x3 real-weight relational-law memory learn action consequences from 10 real intervention-feedback observations per novel world, generalize to unfamiliar multi-path causal compositions, and preserve earlier laws across interference, compared with an independent exact symbolic control and a fully optimized regularized conventional logistic head on the identical observations?

frozen_world.mechanisms: 3 ordered relation types x 3 ordered relation types = 9 possible two-hop causal path kinds; each world has exactly four active latent kinds selected by lowest SHA256('WSP108|LAW|v1|seed|kind') priorities. Latent table is held by oracle, never fed to models.
frozen_world.support: For each world: 9 singleton before->after edge-add interventions, one for each path kind, with binary observed consequence, and one no-path negative control = 10 supervised action-outcome observations. All three arms see identical interventions and feedback.
frozen_world.query: 64 independent counterfactual add/remove interventions per world with 2..5 typed two-hop paths, each on distinct randomized midpoint identity; predictions include before, after and whether the action changes the outcome; no query feedback during evaluation.
frozen_world.entity_ids: SHA256-derived synthetic opaque identifiers for source/midpoint/target; all query entities disjoint from support and from other worlds; ordered relation roles stay known so this tests new entities/new latent mechanism settings, not unseen primitive relation semantics
frozen_world.feature: 9-bit indicator of existence of at least one two-hop path from source to target for each ordered relation pair, derived only from observed before/after edge facts
frozen_world.ground_truth: Boolean OR of the 9 path features AND the private 9-bit latent law; evaluator computes oracle truth only after every model prediction for each frozen cohort is generated and SHA-sealed
frozen_world.source_restriction: synthetic seeded worlds only; never touch historical Wikidata5M, original validation/test, WSP101 protected first-use or accepted Yggdrasil model

arms.direct_numeric: For each world, program a 3x3 float32 matrix from only the 9 singleton action-consequence observations. No SGD; directly set each kind weight 0.0 or 1.0. Predict OR via a numerical matrix dot product with the 9 path-presence indicators. Persist independently keyed world weights with SHA256 tamper-checked snapshot and cold restoration.
arms.independent_symbolic: Completely independent Python dict/set indexed by ordered relation pair, updated from the same 9 singleton observed outcomes. Query OR over supported path-kind membership. Zero protected latent-law access.
arms.conventional: Train an independent L2-regularized binary logistic regression per world on exactly the same ten (9 singleton and one zero-path) path-feature/feedback pairs. A convex Newton solver (max 100 iterations; gradient infinity norm <=1e-9; L2 coefficient 0.03 including intercept; deterministic zero initialization, objective-decreasing backtracking) must reach a stationary fit, and report train accuracy; no query labels or transfer-world oracle used in optimizing model.
arms.no_update_negative: Unprogrammed all-zero direct weights; no action-outcome support, scored on identical query data.
arms.rotated_feedback_negative: Numeric direct weights programmed with cyclically shifted (by one of 9 ordered kinds) singleton feedback labels, but same number of positive labels and observations; should fail more often than correct mapping.

primary: after-action outcome accuracy across 12 unfamiliar transfer worlds x 64 queries
action-causes-change accuracy (before vs after) across same examples
accuracy conditional on true action changes
accuracy conditional on no true action change
per-model predictions SHA256 sealed before query labels consulted
secondary: fit-world and unfamiliar transfer-world metrics separately
unfamiliar latent laws and synthetic entity disjointness asserted
cold exact restoration after 12 intervening world-law updates
training observations and fully optimized logistic gradient residual and train accuracy
whole-process CPU, model wall times and learned parameter counts, no unsupported speedup
measures.frozen_dev_exit: Independent numeric and symbolic must agree 100% with each other and oracle; negative controls must be strictly worse than numeric on transfer, intervention-positive and no-change groups must both be present, conventional solver must reach stationarity or FAIL; even passing these earns DEV_CAUSAL_RULE_COMPOSITION, never SCIENTIFIC_PASS or AGI.

resource.random: Python Random seed derived solely from SHA256(query seed, index)

limits: Deterministic synthetic causal composition is not real-world causal understanding, observationally unidentified external mechanisms, natural-language knowledge, broad AGI, robust novel relation vocabulary, or model superiority over the exact symbolic control. Don't claim independent science from this predeclared DEV experiment.
